title: Frobenius coefficient quotient map
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its recorded coefficient quotients [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], a scheme $X$, and integers $b\ge a\ge0$, define the canonical map of constant coefficient sheaves $A_{E,b+1,X}\to A_{E,a+1,X}$ induced by the quotient $\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{b+1}\to\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{a+1}$. The map is the quotient map itself and imposes no flatness assumption.
